description: 원자력안전위원회_국내 원자력발전소 사건에 대한 발생 계통별 원인별 현황 [nuclear facilities and electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 원자력안전위원회. 국내 원자력발전소 사건 관련 원인을 분류한 연도별 데이터입니다. (2011~2025년) - 본 데이터는 원자력발전소의 사건 원인을 발생 위치에 따른 계통별(1,2차로 분류) 분류와,. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 원자력안전위원회. Its tags are 원자력발전소, 사고 및 고장, 계통별 현황, 원인별 현황, 연도별 데이터. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-07-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
